     * Prisma relation modes:

// Represents a JSON Schema for a data point that we collect from candidates.

model CandidateDataPointSchema {
    id        String   @id @default(cuid())
    createdAt DateTime @default(now())
    updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

    // Unique identifier for this type of data point across versions
    // e.g. "years_of_experience", "licenses", "preferred_salary"
    schemaKey String

    // Version number for this schema (increments when schema is updated)
    version Int @default(1)

    // Whether this is the currently active version for new data points
    isActive Boolean @default(true)

    // The default way to ask the candidate for this data point.
    // e.g. "What is your preferred salary?"
    defaultPrompt String
    // A JSON Schema that describes the data point.
    jsonSchema    Json
    // Metadata for UI and other non-schema data (e.g., property order, migration rules)
    metadata      Json?

    candidateDataPoints CandidateDataPoint[]

    @@unique([schemaKey, version])
    @@index([schemaKey])
    @@index([schemaKey, isActive])
}

    updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

    candidateId String

    engagementId String?
    engagement   Engagement? @relation(fields: [engagementId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

    // Optional relation to Opportunity (if data was collected for a specific opportunity)
    opportunityId String?
    opportunity   Opportunity? @relation(fields: [opportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

    // References the specific version of the schema used when this data was collected
    dataPointSchemaId String
    dataPointSchema   CandidateDataPointSchema @relation(fields: [dataPointSchemaId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

    value Json

    @@index([candidateId])
    @@index([dataPointSchemaId])
    @@index([engagementId])
    @@index([opportunityId])
}
